name: bylaws
description: Shows Bylaws architecture rule violations in Swift files.

bylaws.serverPath.markdownDescription: Path to the `bylaws-lsp` executable. An empty value searches `PATH` and the standard Homebrew locations. Reload the editor to apply a change.

bylaws.rules.markdownDescription: Rules files to load, as paths relative to the workspace folder. An empty list discovers the `Bylaws.swift` files. Reload the editor to apply a change.

bylaws.only.description: IDs of the rules to run. An empty list runs every rule. Reload the editor to apply a change.

bylaws.skip.description: IDs of the rules to skip. Reload the editor to apply a change.

bylaws.baseline.markdownDescription: Recorded baseline file, as a path relative to the workspace folder. An empty value discovers the `Bylaws.baseline.swift` files. Reload the editor to apply a change.

bylaws.refreshDelayMilliseconds.description: Time to wait after the last keystroke before the rules run again. Raise it on a codebase where a run for each keystroke costs too much. Reload the editor to apply a change.
